pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/routes/mod.rs:1005 The openapi approval snapshot's record switch is an environment variable. When it is set, the test rewrites clients/openapi.json and returns green, and no pipeline refusal or integrity test exists (a grep finds UPDATE_OPENAPI only in the justfile recipe and the client generator), so an inherited UPDATE_OPENAPI makes the snapshot test unfalsifiable.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/routes/mod.rs:1005 Runtime-flag switch with no CI refusal and no integrity test. The comparison is also line-text first-difference (line 1025), not structural with a key path.

crates/server/src/routes/error.rs:454 Source-text pin skips comment prose, and its population is derived by walking src/ rather than a hand list (line 415). Trailing comments and string literals can still match the needle.
crates/server/src/routes/error.rs:426 The scan declares a floor on what it must select, so a scan that sees nothing fails instead of passing green over zero files.
